newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Core blue chips seen lifting S.Korean stock market.
newsitem.headline: Core blue chips seen lifting S.Korean stock market.

text.p: Seoul stocks are expected to continue their rally on Wednesday with active buying remaining strong in core blue chips, brokers said, forecasting the index would test the psychological 800 level.
But investors are likely to shy away from Kia Group shares on concerns about financial troubles, even though the group strongly denied the speculation.
"The market is expected to test the 800 level. The bullishness is unlikely to die easily," said Park Key-pyong of Hanyang Securities.
The composite stock index closed on Tuesday at 792.29.
